opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The FIR unfolds that the petitioner had a love relationship with the informant.
On 29.11.2023, the petitioner took the informant with false promises of marriage.
Thereafter, the petitioner started to subject the informant to cruelty and after 1 months, the petitioner drove out the informant from his house.
It is further submitted that no case under section 420 of the IPC has been made out against the petitioner as there is no instance of cheating and the petitioner is willing to marry the informant, but the informant is not willing to marry the petitioner and she has slammed a false case against the petitioner.
9.

The petitioner has not violated any bail conditions.

11. In the above terms, this Anticipatory Bail application stands disposed of.
